subject: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Arielle Morris <arielle.morris@peninsulasystems.com>, Tom Keegan <tom.keegan@peninsulasystems.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios

Hi Arielle / Tom,

Thanks again for the time last week — attached is a short healthscore + ROI recap for Peninsula covering the last 90 days (attachment: peninsula_healthscore_q3.pdf). Key highlights:

- Consumption: ~18M tokens used in the last 90 days; 60% growth quarter-over-quarter driven by recommender and chat assist features.
- Cost & unit economics: weighted per-token cost currently ~$0.0019 after credits; anticipated unit down to ~$0.0014 with a 30% commit and optimized batching.
- Performance: median generation latency is 220ms (95th = 480ms) for your typical 256-token requests; we have safe options to reduce 95th percentile via dedicated lanes or small model variants for less-critical paths.
- Risk: prefix cache hit-rate is only 12% on the recommender path — small prompt engineering + caching would yield ~15% immediate token savings.

Proposed next steps (three commit scenarios we think map to your roadmap):

1) 12-month 30% token commit — lowers per-token to ~$0.0014, includes 10% onboarding credit for migration to improved batching.
2) 12-month 50% commit + dedicated capacity pilot (3 GPUs reserved) — target per-token ~$0.0010, reduces 95th latency by ~30%.
3) 24-month staged commit (year 1 = 30%, year 2 = +20%) — better unit economics with an additional 5% term discount; recommended if Peninsula expects growth >2x next 12 months.

I flagged preferred option #2 given your latency goals for the recommender. If you want, I can pull together a one-page executive ROI that shows NPV and simple payback under each scenario.

Attached: peninsula_healthscore_q3.pdf (one-pager + token breakdown)

Would you be available for a 30-minute follow-up this week to walk the numbers and procurement timeline?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
From: Arielle Morris <arielle.morris@peninsulasystems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Keegan <tom.keegan@peninsulasystems.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios

Dylan — thanks for the note and the PDF. Quick Qs before we schedule:

- Can you produce the executive ROI with blended monthly costs and an expected 18–24 month forecast? Procurement will need a clear delta vs current spend.
- On option #2, what would the SLA/uptime guarantee look like and do we need any special IP/data language for the dedicated pilot?
- What is the timeline for DocuSign once we agree on terms (we typically need legal + procurement sign-off in 7–10 business days).

If you can send the ROI and a short bulleted SOW we can tentatively book time Wednesday afternoon.

—Arielle
Arielle Morris
Head of Product Operations | Peninsula Systems
arielle.morris@peninsulasystems.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios (internal)

Folks — Arielle asked for an exec ROI and SOW bullets; procurement wants 7–10 business days to sign. I recommend we take option #2 (12m, 50% commit + dedicated pilot) and offer the following concessions to close quickly:

- 10% one-time onboarding credit (applied in month 1)
- 3-month burst credit pool (equivalent to 250k tokens) to cover initial tuning spikes
- Standard Redwood Dedicated pilot SLA (99.9% uptime) — legal to confirm IP/data language but we can include a carve-out: customer data never leaves their VPC for the pilot.

Numbers: we modeled expected blended per-token of ~$0.00105 with these concessions. If we cut deeper (15% discount) finance needs a written justification.

Can Lauren/Monica please confirm pricing approval and signoff authority to present these terms to Arielle? I can prep the ROI and a 1-page SOW by EOD.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios (internal)

Dylan / Lauren — reviewed. Finance is comfortable with option #2 plus the concessions below:

- 12-month term, 50% token commit (RDW-4521)
- 10% onboarding credit (one-time)
- 3-month burst credit pool (250k tokens)
- 10% term discount applied to list; finance approves up to 10% discount without exec escalation.
- Reserved pilot capacity to be billed monthly; include a 30-day free trial period for the pilot to allow tuning.

Legal: include standard Dedicated pilot addendum and the data locality clause (customer data stays in their VPC). Monica will run the SOW and the pilot addendum through Legal—aiming for a clean DocuSign envelope by COB Wednesday.

Monica Patel
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Keegan <tom.keegan@peninsulasystems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arielle Morris <arielle.morris@peninsulasystems.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Peninsula Systems — Q3 healthscore, ROI recap & commit scenarios

Dylan / Monica — that sounds reasonable and aligns with our internal forecasts. Arielle and I chatted — we can move forward with option #2 on the terms Monica outlined. Two small asks before we sign:

1) Can you add a 60-day termination window for the pilot if performance metrics (95th latency reduction targets) are not met after tuning?
2) Please include an appendix listing the contact points for incident escalation and bridging between our infra team and Redwood SREs.

If you add those two items to the SOW, we will route to procurement and legal; expect us to return a signed DocuSign within 7 business days. Please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Keegan
VP Engineering | Peninsula Systems
